description:
Close the final holistic finding by making the canonical failure-lever registry obey its keyed-by-command-path contract.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The typed registry validation rejects any duplicate `path` across invocation and exemption entries.
- [hard] REQ-02: The committed registry contains exactly one row per reflected machine-readable command path; the redundant `serve --stop` and `serve --status` registry rows are removed while the dedicated serve failure-envelope test continues to cover start, stop, and status branches.
- [hard] REQ-03: The generated live census remains definition-derived at 100 unique arms (98 invoked probes and 2 justified exemptions), with invoked/exempt accounting and envelope/status checks unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-04: Registry tests remain independent of managed planning artifacts and the full Rust and independent code-review gates pass.

## Notes

The authoritative plan keys registry entries by command path. `serve` is one reflected arm with three separately tested failure branches; only one registry lever is needed for per-arm conformance.
title: Enforce one failure-lever registration per command path
